statement: The Texas Unemployment Compensation Act requires an employer to register with the Texas Workforce Commission within 10 days of becoming liable for unemployment tax, and registration runs through the Commission's free online Unemployment Tax Registration service.
caveat: The liability triggers (wage thresholds, employment duration, acquisitions) live in the Act and TWC guidance, and some employer types cannot use the online service; Texas has no state individual income tax, so there is no state wage-withholding registration. The statute host serves a JS-only shell to non-browser clients, so this rule rests on the agency page.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (state process variants wave 2026-10-22); independent domain expert review pending
